rationale: The proposed topology improves the binding constraints—specifically NF and S21—by adding a source degeneration inductor in series with the NMOS transistor’s source, enhancing input matching and noise performance while maintaining stability. The added inductor tunes the input impedance to better match 50Ω, reducing reflection and improving gain, which directly addresses both the high NF and low S21 margins. The inductor also increases the effective source impedance, which suppresses noise gain and improves NF without significantly increasing power or degrading S11. The design remains within device budget and maintains narrowband operation via resonant tuning.
